_meta.purpose: Source of truth for generating one master ecosystem artwork that represents the full Good Flippin Design universe.
notes: This file is intentionally symbolic rather than exhaustive.
Use motif and mood fields to encode each project into a single artwork without creating a logo collage.
Externally verified public properties outrank local-only directories when deciding what belongs in the visible canon.
Unresolved slots such as AETC should remain optional edge references rather than primary visual load unless explicitly promoted.
